selection: Lowest shell envelope among500 reviewed; not global optimum; near-tied designs remain equivalent within numerical precision. Three highest panel shell envelopes; two highest existing spans per panel.
variables_only: Additional F1 winding shells and associated actual self-weight; original F0 geometry, materials, beam sections, supports and lateral point forces frozen.
new_anchor_assumption: Existing original ribbon midpoint acts as perfectly bonded new winding anchor; no new ground support. Local contact/hardware capacity not analyzed.
ab_assumption: Original A/B anchors separately, index step6 on13anchors; nonplanar original anchor coordinates retained.
mass_comparison: As-built candidate quantities differ; report added winding mass and performance per added mass; no equal-mass claim.
